title: Datadog API key: benign encoded value controls
summary: 1 input holding benign encoded or hashed values of the same general shape.
rationale: Hashes, checksums and encoded text share alphabets and lengths with credentials. Reporting them is a false alarm that grows with repository size.

expectation.rationale: Public identifier or benign encoding constructed to contain no credential: silence follows from construction.
